INDIANAPOLIS 46204 
ROOM 212, STATE HOUSE 633-5610
STATE BUDGET AGENCY
June 21, 1972
Mr. Gates M. Barker, Jr.
Acting Chief
Office of Environmental Quality
Bureau of Sport Fisheries & Wildlife
Department of Interior
Washington, D. C.
Dear Mr. Barker:
The State Planning and Development Clearinghouse has reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972.
Please refer to the comments attached to this page. For the reasons outlined by the Indiana Department of Natural Resources, the State cannot endorse the legislation as currently proposed.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this proposal.
Sincerely,
Daniel A. Novreske
Clearinghouse Review Officer
Danial a. Noveske
Enclosure
